row.evidence: Cursor's pricing page lists "SCIM seat management" under Enterprise (Custom) while Teams ($40/user/mo) includes SAML/OIDC SSO; the SCIM docs say it is "Available on Enterprise plans with SSO enabled".
row.notes: Classic SSO-yes, SCIM-no middle tier: SAML/OIDC SSO is included on Teams ($40/user/mo Standard seat, $120 Premium seat) at no extra cost, SCIM only on Enterprise (Contact Sales). The $40 is the monthly price shown by default; a Yearly toggle exists but its price could not be captured (headless renderer failed on cursor.com). SCIM needs an active SSO connection; IdP unassignment removes the member from the team (account and data kept). Okta/Entra/Google catalogue apps not found on vendor-linked pages; Cursor points to external IdP guides. Admin API (list members, audit logs) is labelled 'Enterprise teams' in the API overview, while the Teams pricing doc says usage stats are available via the Admin API; remove-member is Enterprise only.
